statements.status_notes: PostgreSQL fixed CVE-2026-116335 (PostgreSQL commutator or negator result-type confusion executes arbitrary code) in 16.16 on the PostgreSQL 16 branch: https://www.postgresql.org/support/security/CVE-2026-116335/ lists 16.16 as the fixed release for major version 16, and the 16.16 release notes, https://www.postgresql.org/docs/release/16.16/, list this CVE. The fix is commit https://github.com/postgres/postgres/commit/85420b358863b4851a5b5f79be38b0d2869c6a20 on the REL_16_STABLE branch, which changes src/backend/catalog/pg_operator.c, src/backend/commands/operatorcmds.c and src/include/catalog/pg_operator.h (plus regression tests) so that CREATE and ALTER OPERATOR check that a commutator or negator returns the same data type and refuse inconsistent reciprocal links; it is tagged Security: CVE-2026-116335 and Backpatch-through: 14; that commit is in the REL_16_16 release tag and not in REL_16_15. The DHI postgresql16 packages for Alpine 3.23 are built from Alpine's postgresql16 APKBUILD, https://github.com/alpinelinux/aports/blob/859fa0795e895af033fab32094a83301f2b4d8ff/community/postgresql16/APKBUILD, which builds the upstream PostgreSQL release tarball; none of the patches it applies touch the files this fix changes. We checked the postgres server binary, /usr/libexec/postgresql16/postgres, in every published postgresql16 package for Alpine 3.23 on both x86_64 and aarch64 (checksums verified against the package index): 16.16-r0 reports PostgreSQL 16.16 and carries the fix, while the earlier builds 16.13-r0, 16.14-r0 and 16.15-r0 report 16.13, 16.14 and 16.15 and are affected. As a check, the 16.16-r0 server binary contains the error messages this fix adds ("commutator operator %s is already the commutator of operator %s", "negator operator %s is already the negator of operator %s" and "commutator operator %s does not return the same data type as operator %s") on both architectures, and the server binaries of 16.13-r0, 16.14-r0 and 16.15-r0 do not. 16.16-r0 is the first published build that carries the fix. Alpine's postgresql16 APKBUILD lists CVE-2026-116335 under its 16.16-r0 secfixes.

CVE-2026-116335 (PostgreSQL commutator or negator result-type confusion executes arbitrary code) is fixed upstream in PostgreSQL 17.12 for the 17 major version: https://www.postgresql.org/support/security/CVE-2026-116335/ and the 17.12 release notes, https://www.postgresql.org/docs/release/17.12/. Alpine's postgresql17 17.12-r0 on the 3.23-stable branch is the upgrade to 17.12 and lists CVE-2026-116335 under its secfixes; see https://security.alpinelinux.org/vuln/CVE-2026-116335. The DHI postgresql17 17.12-r0 build for Alpine 3.23 is built from that APKBUILD, and its postgres server binary reports PostgreSQL 17.12 on both x86_64 and aarch64. Every earlier published build for Alpine 3.23 (17.7-r0, 17.8-r0, 17.9-r0, 17.10-r0 and 17.11-r0) reports an older 17.x release, so it is affected; 17.12-r0 and later carry the fix.

CVE-2026-116335 (PostgreSQL commutator or negator result-type confusion executes arbitrary code): an object creator could link operators with different result types as commutator or negator, or create inconsistent reciprocal links, and so execute arbitrary code as the operating system user running the database. PostgreSQL fixed it in 18.7: https://www.postgresql.org/support/security/CVE-2026-116335/ lists 18.7 as the fixed release for major version 18, and the 18.7 release notes are https://www.postgresql.org/docs/release/18.7/. The fix is commit https://github.com/postgres/postgres/commit/165bbc265631f937b6396df3bfcac7e6520618e3 on the REL_18_STABLE branch, tagged Security: CVE-2026-116335, in the REL_18_7 release tag and not in REL_18_6. It makes CREATE OPERATOR and ALTER OPERATOR, in src/backend/catalog/pg_operator.c and src/backend/commands/operatorcmds.c, reject a commutator or negator that does not return the same data type, keep a shell operator's back-link, and require the same creating role when an operator fills in a shell operator; its other changes are pg_operator.h and regression tests. The DHI postgresql18 packages for Alpine 3.23 are built from Alpine's postgresql18 APKBUILD, https://github.com/alpinelinux/aports/blob/59a1f1d230675807d5a95a0c1e57ba5d640ba039/main/postgresql18/APKBUILD, which builds the upstream PostgreSQL release tarball; none of the patches it applies touch the files this fix changes, and it lists CVE-2026-116335 under its 18.7-r0 secfixes. The DHI Alpine 3.23 package repository publishes the postgresql18 package at 18.1-r0, 18.2-r0, 18.3-r0, 18.4-r0, 18.6-r0 and 18.7-r0. We checked the postgres server binary, /usr/libexec/postgresql18/postgres, in every one of those packages on both x86_64 and aarch64, each against its index checksum: 18.7-r0 reports PostgreSQL 18.7 and contains the two error messages the fix adds for a mismatched result type (commutator operator ... does not return the same data type as operator ..., and the same for a negator), while 18.1-r0, 18.2-r0, 18.3-r0, 18.4-r0 and 18.6-r0 report 18.1, 18.2, 18.3, 18.4, 18.6 and contain neither message; the message operator cannot be its own negator, which both versions have, is present in every build as a control. The earlier builds are upstream releases before 18.7, so they are affected; 18.7-r0 is the first published build that carries the fix.

PostgreSQL fixed CVE-2026-116335, a result-type confusion through operator commutator and negator links that lets an object creator execute arbitrary code, in 17.12 (https://www.postgresql.org/support/security/CVE-2026-116335/, https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-116335, https://www.postgresql.org/docs/release/17.12/). Earlier 17 releases are affected. The server binary in this owner's 17.12-0 build and in its rebuild of Debian's 17.12-0+deb13u1 reports PostgreSQL 17.12 on amd64 and arm64, so both carry the fix. The 17.11-1 build and the current rebuild of Debian's 17.11-0+deb13u1 report PostgreSQL 17.11, and the earlier rebuilds of Debian's 17.10-0+deb13u1 and 17.11-0+deb13u1, no longer in the repository, package PostgreSQL 17.10 and 17.11. All of these are affected and sort below 17.12-0.
